scope: HIL-NFR-16, HIL-NFR-17, HIL-NFR-18 source conditions against exact current/adopted L2/L11 pairs and relevant unadopted candidates. Read-only source inspection; no legacy runtime, test, CLI, or CI execution.

HIL-NFR-16.text: quarantineはexact fingerprintだけに適用し、無期限、wildcard、directory単位、全check一括を禁止する。期限切れ、対象変更、fingerprint変化で失効する。

HIL-NFR-17.text: product dataはclassification、最小取得、redaction、retention、freshness SLAを持ち、PII/secret/raw payloadを通常projectionやagent contextへ複製しない。

HIL-NFR-18.text: agent lease失効後のtool call/artifact/completionはfencing token不一致で拒否し、crash後は最後のdurable checkpointからだけ再開する。

condition_crosswalk.current_evidence: Adopted L2/L11-032 require check identity, explicit version, known fingerprint and baseline; L11 negative oracle rejects changed fingerprint, undeclared version and wildcard policy. HIL-06c consumer also requires exact-known-only. This is held.

condition_crosswalk.condition: no directory-unit or all-check bulk exception
condition_crosswalk.current_evidence: Adopted 032 represents eligibility as a check-unit exception, binds an exact check identity/version and known fingerprint, and explicitly rejects wildcard. These rules appear to disallow broad exceptions semantically; there is no separate directory/all-check negative fixture in 032. Absence of a named fixture alone is not a gap. Keep this as textual interpretation, not a claim of explicit directory-level oracle.
condition_crosswalk.finding: likely encompassed by adopted per-check exactness; explicit negative fixture not present

condition_crosswalk.condition: expiry, target change, or fingerprint change invalidates exception
condition_crosswalk.current_evidence: Fingerprint change and expiry/limit exhaustion are explicit. Current run HEAD/tree and policy baseline are separate; policy must include current run in its declared scope. The adopted pair does not explicitly state that an otherwise in-scope target HEAD/tree change invalidates an already recorded eligibility/receipt. A changed target still within the policy scope could meet the stated membership test.

condition_crosswalk.condition: after crash, resume only from last durable checkpoint
condition_crosswalk.current_evidence: Adopted 019 requires durable event provenance, no successful checkpoint after failed write/projection, reconstruct from source events, and preserve unfinished obligations; L11 rejects provider-memory-only restart. This rules out some stale/uncommitted restart paths. It does not explicitly identify the latest durable checkpoint as the sole restart cursor or reject resumption from an older checkpoint while a later durable one exists.
condition_crosswalk.finding: potential residual: latest-durable-checkpoint-only selection not explicit; existing replay-from-events may satisfy operational continuity but does not prove the source's exclusive checkpoint ordering condition
